store.frontierhunts.blurb.hound_lead: Your tracking hound: finds the deer you wounded
store.frontierhunts.blurb.milkweed_pods: 12 puffs: watch the wind 30 m out
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.stores.count: The outfitter's counter only stocks what nobody can make: field gear from town and the tracking hound. Ammunition, batteries, scent cover, first aid and range targets are made at your benches; licences, tags and the game report are at the licence counter.
guide.frontierhunts.lesson.trail.p5: A tracking hound follows the animal's own line. Buy a Hound Lead at the outfitter's counter (Expedition journal, Stores) and use it to call your hound, then hold the lead, look at the blood and press Use.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.intro: The reserve keeps growing. Here's a look down the trail. Not everything, just enough to keep you watching the treeline.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.animals.text: Black bear, grizzly, polar bear, wild boar, bison, pronghorn, coyote, gray wolf, cougar, lion, panther and cheetah.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.animals.note: You may have seen their spawn eggs. Wild herds, seasons, tags and contracts come with each one as it arrives.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.1.title: New hunts
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.1.text: Spring mornings with a box call, predators answering at night, and a couple we're keeping quiet about.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.2.title: More game
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.2.text: Past the twelve above: something big up in the high country, and something you'll only hear after dark.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.3.title: Guns and bows
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.3.text: New rifles, an old-fashioned muzzleloader season, and a few classics every hunter will know on sight.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.4.title: Gear
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.4.text: Climbing saddles, game carts, a better blind and a couple of tools that change how you scout.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.5.title: New country
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.5.text: Whole new hunting regions as expansions: new land, new game and new legends to chase.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.6.title: More legends
journal.frontierhunts.soon.ahead.6.text: Every big-game animal gets a legend of its own. Some won't show up where you expect.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.support.text: Frontier Hunts is made by one developer. Support on Ko-fi goes straight into the next update. It's never required, and nothing in the game is locked behind it.
item.frontierhunts.sled.desc1: Place it, sit on it and point it downhill: snow runs fast. Left/right to steer, back to brake.
item.frontierhunts.sled.desc2: Left/right to carve, back to brake, forward to push off. Sneak + Use to pick it up.
